explanation: The theorem says the image field of the multiplication-by-n pullback on an elliptic curve's function field equals the fixed field of the n-torsion action, and that the extension has degree n^2. It depends on library-specific definitions (mulPull, tors, torsAct, W⁄F.FunctionField). A grep of Mathlib for mulPull and fieldRange_le_fixed found nothing. Mathlib has the general Galois and fixed-point tools (FixedPoints.finrank_eq_card, Subfield.relfinrank), which the proof already uses. It has no result about elliptic-curve multiplication maps, so I found no duplicate.
